correctness.rationale: Disjoint-union closure preserves every permitted atomic sentence, including strict inequalities. Every additive positive set has finitely many least occupied-residue representatives modulo its minimum. A finite partition into pairwise-disjoint covering blocks of equal sizes within each generator group realizes exactly sums of those generators, with zero-sized parts allowed but the domain nonempty. Contradictory inclusions realize the empty spectrum. The 23 independent bounded exact enumeration comparisons (412071 assignments) passed, but the infinite statement is justified by these unrestricted arguments, not brute force.

value.rationale: A complete necessary-and-sufficient classification for the exact noun-level Boolean extension raised in Jiang §5.1 is a natural missing piece. It explains which numerical information is gained by noun unions, gives constructive finite axiomatizations for all positive additive semigroups, and strictly surpasses the one-example 3-divisibility demonstration with semigroups such as <4,7> having irregular gaps. It neither relies on an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice nor merely repeats the earlier base-language classification.
